title: Flavor manifest (flavor.json)
description: An optional manifest for a setting (mod): a directory under bridge/flavors/<id>/. The directory name is the flavor id, and the conventional files (units.json, theme.css, ships.json, callsigns.json, missions/) are found automatically, so a manifest only needs the keys it wants to change. A flavor is standalone unless it names a parent with extends. A missing flavor.json is fine when the folder carries conventional data files.

id.description: Optional assertion of the flavor id. Omit it: the directory name is the id. When present it must match the directory, so a stale id on a copied folder fails to load. Hull and mission ids are namespaced <id>.<name> by convention.

extends.description: Flavor id to inherit from. Omit it (or set null) for a standalone setting that carries its own complete catalog.

units.description: Path (relative to the flavor directory) to a units.json document. Omit for units.json; null disables the conventional file.

theme.description: Path to a CSS file overriding the :root theme block. Served after activity.css. Omit for theme.css; null disables the conventional file.

ships.description: Path to a ships.json document (hulls, art, defaults). Omit for ships.json; null disables the conventional file.

callsigns.description: Path to a callsigns.json document (name pools and naming style). Omit for callsigns.json; null disables the conventional file.

missions.description: Path to a mission JSON file or a directory of *.json mission documents. Omit for missions/; null disables the conventional directory.

defaultMission.description: Mission id used when a room names no mission. Defaults to the first mission.
